title: Vacancy analysis
subtitle: Paste a vacancy's text — I'll detect the stack, level, and gaps against your profile. Added/parsed skills immediately flow into the radar, roadmap, and analytics.

autoParse.heading: Auto-parse by links
autoParse.description: Goes through every added vacancy, fetches the text from its link, and updates the stack/level/fit. Data shows up immediately in Skill radar, Analytics, and Roadmap.
autoParse.errorGeneric: Something went wrong during analysis — try again.

textarea.scopeCaption: Quick, one-off check for a posting you haven't saved anywhere — no CV upload or tracked vacancy needed. For a general match against your whole CV profile, use the <cvLink>CV page's "CV vs market"</cvLink>; for a vacancy you've already added to the tracker, use <builderLink>CV Builder's Compare</builderLink>.
